To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

lactic acid bacteria isolated from raw milk samples of dairy farms in the province of Córdoba- Argentina showed different characteristics which can be useful for their application as probiotics in dairy cows to prevent bovine udder infections.
LAB strains from raw milk from dairy farms in Có rdoba-Argentina were isolated.
the LAB strains isolated from the raw milk samples showed a high potential to inhibit the growth of indicator bacteria, and the presence of some virulence factors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the selection of LAB strains with probiotic potential to prevent bovine mammary infections.
the identification of potential beneficial LAB strains from the raw milk of the dairy farm in the province of Córdoba- Argentina.
the isolation and identification of LAB from raw milk, with the evaluation of their beneficial characteristics, the determination of their antibiotic resistance and their safety.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the LAB strains isolated from raw milk in Córdoba are not suitable to be used as probiotics in bovine mastitis prevention, since most of them are not safe and they do not present the desirable beneficial properties.
some of the isolates from the samples of Córdoba are promising strains to be used in the development of probiotic products.
the LAB isolated from raw milk in this area are potential candidates to be used as probiotic products in the dairy industry.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the LAB strains from raw milk in the South of Córdoba-Province are potentially useful for the development of a new probiotic product to be used for the prevention of bovine mastitis and for the control of mastitis-related pathogens.
the LAB isolated in this work are potential candidates to be used as probiotics in the prevention of mastitis in dairy cows.
the LAB strains from the raw milk samples could have potential application for the development of probiotic products to prevent bovine mammary infections.

LAB isolated from foremink samples from different dairy farm in Córdoba, Argentina are potential probiotics to prevent bovine mammary gland infection.
